question: ARC-03's frozen 60-minute holding period can straddle a provider funding settlement, so a deterministic funding CASHFLOW leg is required. Does the repository already hold a certified authority for it, and is it reusable without re-downloading or re-deriving anything?
answer: YES - the independently verified ARC-01 funding authority is reused byte-for-byte. No funding bytes were downloaded or re-derived for ARC-03.

why_funding_is_required.sol_settlement_spacing: 8h nominal with a documented 2h/4h regime during 2022
why_funding_is_required.consequence: roughly one in eight entries of uniformly distributed phase contains at least one settlement inside (entry_time, exit_time]; ignoring the flow would systematically misstate net performance for those trades
why_funding_is_required.role: CASHFLOW LEG ONLY - funding is never an ARC-03 signal input

identity_proof.method: SHA256 equality between the ARC-01 certified partitions and the ARC-03 partitions, recomputed in this worktree; no builder summary is trusted
identity_proof.recomputed_by_reader: load_funding().matches_arc01_authority is asserted True for all three symbols as part of the data authority verification
identity_proof.reason: a byte-identical copy of a certified authority, carrying an explicit provenance pointer and a recomputable identity check, is reuse. No new provider bytes were fetched and no alternative funding series was reconstructed.

field_admission.funding_interval_hours: REQUIRED (per-row cadence; a fixed 8h cadence is never assumed)
field_admission.next_funding_time_ms: REJECTED (derived provider field, not an observation)
field_admission.funding_cap_floor: UNADMITTED (not needed; no adjustment is applied to the certified rate)

boundary_semantics.rule: settlements with entry_time_ms < funding_time_ms <= exit_time_ms are charged
boundary_semantics.entry_instant_settlement: NOT charged (already inside the entry price)
boundary_semantics.settlement_count_never_assumed: the accounting iterates the actual certified rows in the window; no fixed count is hardcoded

sign_convention_verification.reconciliation_test: a synthetic single-settlement trade at a positive rate yields a negative LONG leg and a positive SHORT leg of equal magnitude (verified in the prereg unit tests)
